classes.description: Override or extend the styles applied to the component.

className.description: CSS class applied to the element.

flexItem.description: If true, a vertical divider will have the correct height when used in flex container. (By default, a vertical divider will have a calculated height of 0px if it is the child of a flex container.)

render.description: The element to render, or a function that returns it. Forward the props, ref, and children to preserve Material styles and separator semantics.

style.description: Styles applied to the root element.

sx.description: The system prop that allows defining system overrides as well as additional CSS styles.

root.description: Styles applied to the root element.
